Good morning and welcome to the Jyhad quizz Show !!

1- A vampire with the soul gem on him is banished, then burned via Might of
the camarilla. What happens ?

a-the gem triggers ! yahee !
b-the gem doesn't work, too bad ...
c-someone creates a new ruling =)

2- A vampire is banished, then burnt via Miht of the Camarilla or Gisela's
power. Can the gisela play freak drive and daemonic possess the poor soul ?

a-yeah, and it's a nasty combo !
b-no. There's something weird, i can't say why not, but no.
c-put that on the Rt list for review ;)

3- A torporized vampire is burnt via Sacrificial lamb. Can the acting
vampire play Ritual of bitter rose and/or soul stealing for blood gain ?

a- yes ! by playing them both, i can replenish Quadir and his fidais !
b- no because something happens, but i can't remember what...
c- mmm... reversal : diablerie is now photonic. It occurs at light speed and
you can't play any effect even if you have superior temporis. 'monger said !

4- Providing you have Intisar in play, can you give pool to an ally
methuselah and choose to tap an already tapped vampire ?

a-yup.
b-nop
c-you can't tap someone who's already tapped. Wait card text doesn't say "
to tap " but rather "tap". Since you can tap someone already tapped for the
purpose of brujah debate and toreador grand ball, but need not to not untap
someone not tapped for the purpose of Riddle Phantastique... let me take an
aspirin will you ?

subsidiary question :
5- Is it possible to burn a borrowed vampire by impersonating him into
Kyasid, playing The grandest trick + Rave ?

a- yes. I'll use all those mind rapes, grandest tricks and clan
impersonations...
b- no.
c-...

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"reyda" posed the following questions:

> 1- A vampire with the soul gem on him is banished, then burned
> via Might of the camarilla. What happens ?

b-the gem doesn't work, too bad ...

All cards on a minion in the uncontrolled region are considered
to be out of play and do not affect the minion until he returns
to play.

LSJ 2001-05-30
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3B1573BB.2017225C%40white-wolf.com

> 2- A vampire is banished, then burnt via Miht of the
> Camarilla or Gisela's power. Can the gisela play freak drive
> and daemonic possess the poor soul ?

b-no.

Pertinent card text on Daemonic Possession:
"controlled by another Methuselah"
The vampires in your "uncontrolled" region are not controlled,
by definition.

LSJ 2002-02-08
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3C63F473.FB54FF12%40white-wolf.com

> 3- A torporized vampire is burnt via Sacrificial lamb. Can the
> acting vampire play Ritual of bitter rose and/or soul stealing
> for blood gain ?

d - Ritual of the Bitter Rose - No, Soul Stealing - Yes

Sacrificial Lamb is neither diablerie nor burning a vampire in combat.
LSJ 2001-09-17
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3BA5E7F3.996E67A6%40white-wolf.com

"Any burn-as-action will work [for Soul Stealing]."
LSJ 2002-06-03
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3CFB64F5.E886A56B%40white-wolf.com

> 4- Providing you have Intisar in play, can you give pool to an ally
> methuselah and choose to tap an already tapped vampire ?

a-yup.

You can use Misdirection to tap a minion that is already tapped, and
Intisar has the same text.

[LSJ has not replied to any messages with Intisar in the text, yet.]

(Misdirection answer)
LSJ 2001-02-11
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=9670o9%24kck%241%40nnrp1.deja.com

> 5- Is it possible to burn a borrowed vampire by impersonating him into
> Kyasid, playing The grandest trick + Rave ?

a- yes.

Consider using Precognizant Mobility to untap him after the Clan
Impersonation action. Then you can get it all done on the same turn.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com

--

it seems logical, but... take a closer look at card text :

Daemonic Possession [FN]
[nec] Only usable when a minion controlled by another Methuselah has been
burned since your last turn. Move that minion from his owner's ash heap to
your ready region, put 1 blood or life from the blood bank on the minion and
tap the minion. You now control the minion.
[NEC] As above, but the minion is untapped.

The vampire burnt via Gisela's ability was controlled the same turn, thus
met the requirements dor Daemonic Possesion just before he reached the
uncontrolled region. I can still argue that he was controlled since my last
turn... Is it text lawyering ? maybe ... =)

might be a never seen combo and a good news for all those grandest tricks
